text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created by deploy-bot — staged rollout (eu-west) showing elevated 500 rate and CPU OOMs on runtime-api canary instances. Paging oncall. Thread started at 1768427777

deploy-bot: deployment 2026.3.14-staged started -> routing 10% traffic to variant v2026-03-alpha

alex-chen: I see 5xx spike in traces, auth+generate path. Rolling back?

maya-patel: Confirmed. Metrics: runtime-api 5xx from 0.2% -> 6.8% over 3m. p95 latency up 300ms. Error traces show oom in model-worker: "CUDA out of memory" on batcher.

samir: scaling looked normal, autoscaler didn't kick. Canary cluster has only n1-standard instances. Possibly memory footprint increased with new serializer change.

evie: Can we flip the feature flag to stop sending requests to v2026-03-alpha? Need kill switch first.

alex-chen: Initiating kill switch — feature flag staging.rollout.alpha = off

alex-chen: /ff toggle staging.rollout.alpha false

deploy-bot: feature flag staging.rollout.alpha set to false by alex-chen

incident-bot: routing policy updated: removed target v2026-03-alpha, traffic back to baseline models

maya-patel: 5xx rate dropping but still elevated. Some in-flight batches failed and are retrying, causing secondary pressure.

ryan_ops: I'm draining canary instances and cordoning them from LB. Command:
```
kubectl -n inference cordon deploy/canary-runtime-alpha
kubectl -n inference drain deploy/canary-runtime-alpha --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

samir: Running `kubectl describe pod` shows cache warmup allocating large KV caches; new serializer may be leaking pinned buffers.

evie: Can we roll back the deployment to previous image? I think kill switch + cordon is safer while we prepare rollback.

alex-chen: I've opened a rollback job: `deploy rollback runtime-api --to v2026-03-stable` — started.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started by alex-chen (ID: rb-8672). Estimated time 3-6 minutes.

maya-patel: Customer impact: elevated 5xx for ~12 minutes, affecting ~0.6% of requests in eu-west. No data exfiltration. Inform SRE & PS.

product-ops: Noted. Holding off sending external comms until we've stabilized for 30m. Want a short blurb if this becomes >1% or persists.

samir: Observability note — K8s events show OOMKilled on containers with label image=v2026-03-alpha. Likely a memory regression in that build.

ryan_ops: Rolling back replicasets now. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-api --to-revision=42`

alex-chen: Rollback finished; new pods spinning up on stable image. LB targets updated.

incident-bot: Monitoring: 5xx rate now 0.9% and trending down. p95 latency back to normal within intervals.

evie: I'm still seeing a few flapping canary pods; they should be cordoned and terminated, check node eviction status.

samir: Confirmed all canary pods terminated, no remaining alpha images. Nodes freed memory.

maya-patel: Metrics look good. 5xx back to 0.15% over last 5m. p95 baseline restored.

product-ops: OK to send internal note to customers on impacted EU region? Short note: minor elevated error rate during staged rollout; rollback applied; no customer data impacted.

alex-chen: I'll draft the internal blurb. Also creating a postmortem ticket: PM-4312. Please add any logs/traces.

evie: Quick RCA pointers: serializer change increased GPU memory pinned buffers, didn't manifest in presubmit. Need synthetic load test for batch sizes and KV warmup.

ryan_ops: Action items for handoff:
- samir: bisect alpha build to find offending commit
- maya-patel: add automated canary memory alarms (per-pod RSS + OOMTrend)
- evie: add pre-rollout GPU mem pressure smoke test
- alex-chen: update rollout docs with immediate kill-switch steps and runbook tweaks
- product-ops: customer comm templates ready

samir: I'll start the bisect and attach commit ranges to PM-4312.

maya-patel: I'll add alarms and a dashboard panel. ETA 2d.

alex-chen: Handoff to night oncall @ryan_ops — system stable, rollback completed, monitoring in watch. Please page if 5xx > 1% or CPU/GPU OOMs reappear.

ryan_ops: Acknowledged. I'll monitor for the next 4 hours and take over the ticket.

incident-bot: Incident closed for now (stabilized). Incident duration ~18m. Tags: staged-rollout, rollback, kill-switch.

product-ops: Thanks team. Add customer impact summary to postmortem.

alex-chen: Adding final note to PM-4312 and linking logs. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
